title: Algorithmic Accountability Act of 2023
last_action: Introduced and referred to the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
status: Referred to Senate committee; expired at the end of the 118th Congress
summary: Would have required covered entities to assess automated decision systems used in critical decisions and submit specified information to the Federal Trade Commission.
committee_dynamics: The bill represented a broad accountability model for consequential automated decisions but did not advance before the Congress ended.
advance_rationale: The 118th Congress ended without enactment; any renewed effort requires a new measure in a later Congress.
verification_level: Official GovInfo text and legislative stage checked; end-of-Congress status applied

claim_provenance.note: Inactive/expired status reflects the end of the 118th Congress without enactment.
